enunciado:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence:
"My brother finished college three years _________."
comentario: Usamos 'ago' após a expressão de tempo (three years) para indicar há quanto tempo no passado a ação ocorreu.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence with the appropriate time expression:
"They visited their grandparents _________ month."
comentario: Usamos 'last' antes de unidades de tempo (ex: month, week, year) para significar 'passado' ou 'último'.

enunciado:
Complete the preference statement:
"I would rather _________ a documentary tonight."
comentario: A estrutura 'would rather' (preferir) exige o verbo no infinitivo sem a partícula 'to'.

enunciado: Which of the following is the correct interrogative form using 'would rather'?
alternativas: Would you rather play video games now?
Do you would rather play video games now?
Would you rather to play video games now?
Would rather you play video games now?
Will you rather play video games now?
correta: Would you rather play video games now?
comentario: Para fazer perguntas com 'would rather', invertemos a ordem do sujeito com o auxiliar 'would' (Would you rather...).

enunciado:
Choose the correct verb form to complete the recommendation:
"You had better _________ a coat. It's freezing outside."
comentario: A expressão 'had better' indica um conselho forte e é seguida pelo verbo no infinitivo sem 'to'.

enunciado: What is the correct negative form of the recommendation: "We had better go"?
alternativas: We had better to not go.
comentario: A forma negativa de 'had better' é construída colocando o 'not' logo após a palavra 'better'.

enunciado:
Choose the correct connective based on the sentence structure:
"I was very tired, _________ I took a short nap after lunch."
comentario: Usamos 'so' (então/por isso) após uma vírgula para ligar uma causa ao seu resultado.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence paying attention to punctuation:
"Sarah forgot her keys. _________, she couldn't enter her apartment."
comentario: Usamos 'Therefore' (portanto) no início de uma frase nova, iniciando com letra maiúscula e seguida por vírgula.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence:
"The team practiced every day. _________, they won the championship."
comentario: Após um ponto final, para expressar conclusão ou consequência, iniciamos a frase com 'Therefore' seguido de vírgula.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence showing the cause of the action:
"She bought a large bottle of water _________ she was very thirsty."
comentario: A conjunção 'because' conecta o efeito (comprar água) com a sua causa/motivo (estar com sede).

enunciado:
Complete the sentence:
"We put on our heavy boots _________ it started to snow."
comentario: 'Because' é usado aqui para apresentar a razão ou motivo pelo qual eles calçaram as botas pesadas.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence in the Present Continuous:
"The children _________ in the garden right now."
comentario: Como o sujeito 'The children' é plural, o Present Continuous exige o verbo auxiliar 'are' + verbo principal com '-ing'.

enunciado:
Complete with the correct form of the Present Continuous:
"Your father _________ in the office at the moment."
comentario: Para o sujeito singular 'Your father' (he), a estrutura do Present Continuous é 'is' + verbo com '-ing'.

enunciado: Convert the sentence "The children are playing" into the negative form:
comentario: A forma negativa do Present Continuous é formada adicionando 'not' após o verbo auxiliar 'are'.

enunciado:
Complete with the Simple Past form of the verb:
"Yesterday, we _________ to our new house."
comentario: Para ações concluídas no passado (Yesterday), usamos o Simple Past. O verbo 'move' é regular, bastando acrescentar '-d'.

enunciado:
Complete the promise with the correct future form:
"I promise I _________ help you with your homework."
comentario: Usamos o auxiliar 'will' para fazer promessas ou ofertas espontâneas no futuro.

enunciado:
Complete the prediction about the future:
"I think they _________ to Europe next summer."
comentario: Expressões de opinião ou achismo como 'I think' costumam ser seguidas do futuro simples com 'will'.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence showing a planned future action:
"They _________ visit the museum tomorrow. They already have the tickets."
comentario: Para planos futuros e intenções já decididas, usamos 'be going to'. Como o sujeito é plural (They), usamos 'are going to'.

enunciado: What is the correct negative form of: "They are going to visit the museum tomorrow"?
alternativas: They are not going to visit the museum tomorrow.
They not are going to visit the museum tomorrow.
They won't going to visit the museum tomorrow.
They don't going to visit the museum tomorrow.
They aren't go to visit the museum tomorrow.
correta: They are not going to visit the museum tomorrow.
comentario: Para negar com 'going to', inserimos a partícula 'not' após o verbo auxiliar (am/is/are).

enunciado:
Select the correct interrogative form for a planned action:
"_________ she going to buy a new laptop?"
comentario: Na interrogativa com 'going to', o verbo to be correspondente ao sujeito ('she' exige 'is') deve iniciar a pergunta.

enunciado:
Choose the correct preposition to indicate a specific time in the past:
"The students were studying in the library _________ 8:30 a.m. yesterday."
comentario: Usamos a preposição 'at' para nos referirmos a horários ou momentos precisos do dia (at 8:30 a.m.).

enunciado:
Select the correct preposition for a calendar year:
"We moved to this new house _________ 2021."
comentario: Usamos a preposição 'in' antes de anos específicos no passado (in 2021).

enunciado: Identify the sentence that uses a past time expression INCORRECTLY:
alternativas: We graduated from high school three years last.
They arrived from London last night.
She woke up early at 6:00 a.m. yesterday.
He completed the project two days ago.
correta: We graduated from high school three years last.
comentario: Para indicar 'atrás' após uma expressão de duração de tempo (three years), o correto é usar 'ago', e não 'last'.

enunciado: Rewrite the sentence "I want to watch a documentary tonight" using WOULD RATHER:
alternativas: I would rather watch a documentary tonight.
I would rather to watch a documentary tonight.
I rather would watch a documentary tonight.
I would rather watching a documentary tonight.
I would watch rather a documentary tonight.
correta: I would rather watch a documentary tonight.
comentario: A estrutura de preferência 'would rather' substitui 'want to' e elimina o infinitivo com 'to', usando apenas o verbo básico ('watch').

enunciado: Rewrite the question "Do you want to play video games now?" using WOULD RATHER:
alternativas: Would you rather play video games now?
Do you would rather play video games now?
Would you rather to play video games now?
Would rather you play video games now?
Did you rather play video games now?
correta: Would you rather play video games now?
comentario: Substituímos o auxiliar de pergunta 'Do you want to' por 'Would you rather', seguido diretamente pelo verbo de ação sem 'to'.

enunciado:
Choose the grammatically correct response for the preference:
"Marcus wants to have some coke."
alternativas: Marcus would rather have some coke.
Marcus would rather to have some coke.
Marcus rather would have some coke.
Marcus would rather having some coke.
Marcus would had rather some coke.
correta: Marcus would rather have some coke.
comentario: Para terceira pessoa do singular, 'would rather' permanece invariável e é seguido pelo verbo na forma básica ('have').

enunciado:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate verb combination:
"You _________ careful with that glass. It is broken."
comentario: Had better + base form. Como o adjetivo 'careful' exige o verbo de ligação 'be', usamos 'had better be'.

enunciado:
Complete the warning with the correct option:
"He _________ that old milk. It smells bad."
comentario: Para expressar um conselho negativo ('melhor não beber'), a estrutura correta é 'had better not' + base form ('drink').

enunciado: Which of the following sentences represents a correct strong recommendation?
alternativas: You had better study more for the finals; your grades are low.
You had better to study more for the finals.
You better had study more for the finals.
You had better studying more for the finals.
You has better study more for the finals.
correta: You had better study more for the finals; your grades are low.
comentario: 'Had better' não muda com o tempo verbal do conselho (sempre 'had') e deve preceder diretamente o infinitivo puro.

enunciado: Identify the sentence where the connective and punctuation are used correctly:
alternativas: The weather was extremely hot; therefore, we decided to go to the beach.
The weather was extremely hot, therefore we decided to go to the beach.
The weather was extremely hot. So, we decided to go to the beach.
The weather was extremely hot; so we decided to go to the beach.
The weather was extremely hot therefore, we decided to go to the beach.
correta: The weather was extremely hot; therefore, we decided to go to the beach.
comentario: O conectivo formal 'therefore' deve ser precedido por ponto e vírgula (ou ponto final) e seguido imediatamente por vírgula.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence with the correct connective and punctuation choice:
"The printer ran out of ink _________ we couldn't print the document."
comentario: Para conectar duas orações de forma simples na mesma frase sem quebras formais, a conjunção ', so' (com vírgula antes e sem vírgula depois) é a única correta.

enunciado:
Complete the text:
"John did not wear a coat. _________, he caught a cold."
comentario: Por estar no início de uma frase independente (após ponto final), usamos 'Therefore' seguido de vírgula obrigatoriamente.

enunciado:
Complete the sentence expressing cause and effect:
"They cancelled the picnic _________ the heavy rain was falling."
comentario: Usamos 'because' para introduzir a causa (a chuva forte que caía) pelo cancelamento do piquenique.

enunciado: Select the option that correctly rephrases: "Because it was cold, she wore a scarf."
alternativas: She wore a scarf because it was cold.
She wore a scarf so it was cold.
It was cold because she wore a scarf.
She wore a scarf; therefore it was cold.
She wore a scarf, because, it was cold.
correta: She wore a scarf because it was cold.
comentario: Podemos mover a oração causal para o fim da frase eliminando a vírgula inicial: 'She wore a scarf because it was cold'.

enunciado:
Complete with the correct tense combination:
"While my mother _________ dinner, the telephone suddenly _________."
comentario: Usamos o Past Continuous ('was cooking') para uma ação longa em andamento no passado que foi interrompida por uma ação curta no Past Simple ('rang').

enunciado: Identify the sentence that shows an action in progress in the past:
alternativas: They were playing video games at 9:00 p.m. yesterday.
They play video games every day.
They are playing video games now.
They will play video games tomorrow.
correta: They were playing video games at 9:00 p.m. yesterday.
comentario: O Past Continuous (were playing) indica uma ação contínua ou em progresso em um momento específico do passado (at 9:00 p.m. yesterday).

enunciado: Which sentence is in the Present Continuous interrogative form?
alternativas: Is your father working in the office right now?
Does your father work in the office right now?
Your father is working in the office right now?
Is working your father in the office right now?
Are your father working in the office right now?
correta: Is your father working in the office right now?
comentario: Perguntas no Present Continuous iniciam com a forma do verbo to be ('is') seguida do sujeito ('your father') e do verbo principal em '-ing'.

enunciado:
Complete with WILL or WON'T according to the context:
"She studied hard all week, so she _________ fail her math exam."
comentario: O contexto lógico indica que, por ter estudado bastante, ela 'não vai reprovar' (won't fail) no exame.

enunciado: Complete the question: "_________ he _________ the driving test tomorrow?" (affirmative projection)
comentario: A estrutura de pergunta de previsão futura com will é: Will + sujeito + verbo base (Will he pass).

enunciado:
Complete the dialogue using plans/intentions:
"Why are you buying flour and eggs?"
"Because I _________ bake a cake for Sarah's birthday."
comentario: Como há uma intenção planejada evidente (comprar ingredientes antes), o uso de 'am going to' é o mais adequado.

enunciado:
Analyze the sentences and choose the option where all time expressions are grammatically correct:
I. He finished his project three days ago.
II. The kids were sleeping at midnight last night.
III. We traveled to Japan on 2022.
IV. She met her best friend in last month.
comentario: A sentença III está incorreta porque anos exigem a preposição 'in' (in 2022). A sentença IV está incorreta pois não se usa preposição antes de 'last month'.

enunciado:
Choose the correct negative preference structure using 'would rather':
"I want to stay home. I don't want to go to the party."
alternativas: I would rather not go to the party.
I would rather don't go to the party.
I would not rather go to the party.
I would rather to not go to the party.
I wouldn't rather go to the party.
correta: I would rather not go to the party.
comentario: Para negar uma preferência, inserimos 'not' logo após 'rather' seguido do verbo básico: 'would rather not' + verb.

enunciado: Convert the question "Do you want to invite Jason to the party?" into the equivalent preference question:
alternativas: Would you rather invite Jason to the party?
Would you rather to invite Jason to the party?
Do you would rather invite Jason to the party?
Would you rather inviting Jason to the party?
Rather would you invite Jason to the party?
correta: Would you rather invite Jason to the party?
comentario: A forma equivalente de expressar preferência substitui o desejo geral (Do you want to invite) por 'Would you rather' + verbo base ('invite').

enunciado:
Analyze the sentences with 'had better' and determine which are grammatically correct:
1. You had better to unplug the toaster before cleaning it.
2. We had better stop talking before the teacher gets angry.
3. They had better not be late for the exam.
comentario: A frase 1 está errada porque 'had better' não aceita a partícula 'to' antes do verbo principal (o correto seria 'had better unplug').

enunciado:
Select the correct punctuation and connective combination to merge these clauses:
"The car broke down" and "They had to call a mechanic"
alternativas: The car broke down; therefore, they had to call a mechanic.
The car broke down, therefore they had to call a mechanic.
The car broke down; so they had to call a mechanic.
The car broke down. Therefore they had to call a mechanic.
The car broke down, so, they had to call a mechanic.
correta: The car broke down; therefore, they had to call a mechanic.
comentario: Para unir duas orações independentes em um único período com 'therefore', usa-se ponto e vírgula antes e vírgula depois.

enunciado: Choose the option that represents an INCORRECT usage of punctuation with connectives:
alternativas: He studied all night, therefore, he got a perfect score.
He studied all night; therefore, he got a perfect score.
He studied all night. Therefore, he got a perfect score.
He studied all night, so he got a perfect score.
Because he studied all night, he got a perfect score.
correta: He studied all night, therefore, he got a perfect score.
comentario: Usar apenas uma vírgula antes de 'therefore' (com ou sem vírgula depois) causa um erro gramatical chamado 'comma splice'. Exige-se ponto ou ponto e vírgula.

enunciado: Identify the sentence where the Past Continuous is used correctly to show parallel actions in progress simultaneously in the past:
alternativas: While my sister was studying in her bedroom, I was playing video games in the living room.
While my sister studied in her bedroom, I was playing video games.
My sister was studying in her bedroom when I played video games.
My sister was studying in her bedroom while I played video games.
While my sister was studying, I had played video games.
correta: While my sister was studying in her bedroom, I was playing video games in the living room.
comentario: Quando duas ações longas ocorrem ao mesmo tempo no passado, usamos o Past Continuous em ambas as orações, ligadas por 'while'.

enunciado:
Choose the correct option that completes both blanks:
"Yesterday at 3 p.m., I _________ (read) a book when my brother _________ (shout) for help."
comentario: Uma ação contínua no passado (was reading) foi interrompida de repente por um evento pontual no passado simples (shouted).

enunciado: Choose the option where 'will' or 'won't' is used correctly according to formal English rules:
alternativas: I'm sure the team will win the championship; they have the best players.
I'm sure the team won't winning the championship.
I think the team is going to win the championship because I saw them practice yesterday.
The team will winning the championship next year.
The team won't to win the championship.
correta: I'm sure the team will win the championship; they have the best players.
comentario: Previsões subjetivas baseadas em crença ('I'm sure') usam o 'will' seguido do verbo no infinitivo puro ('win').

enunciado: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'be going to' to represent a future prediction based on present physical evidence:
alternativas: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain soon.
Look at those dark clouds! It will rain soon.
Look at those dark clouds! It is raining soon.
Look at those dark clouds! It rains soon.
Look at those dark clouds! It is going to raining soon.
correta: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain soon.
comentario: Quando fazemos uma previsão sobre o futuro baseada em evidência física clara presente (ex: nuvens escuras), usamos 'be going to'.
